advice: Abstain. The supplied full512 kernel already uses contiguous 16-lane FP32 loads for each operand and contiguous 16-lane stores for each output row segment. The general C path uses contiguous SVE loads and horizontal stores. The contract gives no alignment guarantee for A, B, or C, so an aligned-only access change is unsupported. I know no distinct legal vector-access change from the supplied evidence.
risks: Changing the access width or grouping could alter the layout or require unsupported alignment assumptions. The paired LD1W loads have no post-index writeback form, and replacing them would change the experiment. No performance effect is established.
